quality.freshPromptExact: 12/12 outputs byte-identical to the paired baseline case in the same round, and identical to the six fresh-prompt hashes the sibling entry lists against the published path, with equal completion-token counts (47, 16, 42, 23, 51, 19)

rows.notes: 12.7397 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 78.50 tokens/s median. Bundle swap alone (K=4/flush 32 on the lookahead bundle vs the shipped bundle, same run): 1.008x (1.004-1.030), confirming the two bundles are equivalent outside the lookahead path. A 4B decode step is roughly twice the GPU work of a 1.7B step, so the fixed per-burst cost the lookahead hides is a smaller fraction of the token, which is why this paired ratio (1.063x) is below the 1.7B sibling entry's 1.136x; treat that as an upper bound for a quiet machine, not a claim about a quiet number.

caveat: All absolutes were taken while ORCA saturated the CPU. Lookahead hides CPU-side gaps behind GPU execution and a saturated CPU widens them, so the paired 1.063x is an upper bound for a quiet machine. A 4B decode step is roughly twice the GPU work of the 1.7B sibling entry's step, so the fixed per-burst cost the lookahead hides is a smaller fraction of the token; that is the reason this ratio is smaller than the 1.7B entry's 1.136x. No quiet-machine number or projection is claimed. As of this writing the workbench PR (OlehZhyhinas/webnn-workbench#16, branch qwen4-fable) that recorded this pass is not yet merged.
